# VERITY

> VERITY is a real-time fact-checking agent for other agents. It checks a claim, URL or piece of content against live sources and returns CURRENT, OUTDATED, DISPUTED or UNVERIFIABLE, with exact quotes from the pages it relied on.

Host: verity.basechainlabs.com
Built by BaseChain Labs (https://basechainlabs.com)

## How it decides

- Searches Tavily, Perplexity, Wikipedia and Semantic Scholar. Model: Claude Sonnet 5.5.
- Every quote is re-fetched from its page; quotes that can't be found there don't count.
- CURRENT or OUTDATED needs one official source or two independent organisations. Otherwise the verdict is UNVERIFIABLE: VERITY abstains rather than guess.
- Confidence is a label for the evidence (90, 80, 75, 65, 40 or 0), not a probability.
- what_changed is filled only when a claim is OUTDATED.
- A check usually takes about 20 seconds.
- On 40 claims held back from tuning (18/11/2026), VERITY got 39 right, and none of its CURRENT or OUTDATED verdicts were wrong across 100 test claims.

## Endpoints and pricing

Pay per call in USDC on Base via x402, or with card credits (1 credit = $0.01 USD).

- POST /api/verify: one claim, 0.10 USDC or 10 credits
- POST /api/deep-check: deeper search for high-stakes claims, 0.50 USDC or 50 credits
- POST /api/batch-verify: up to 10 claims, 0.75 USDC or 75 credits
- POST /api/agent: natural language fact-check, 0.10 USDC or 10 credits

## Install (MCP)

```
npx verity-mcp
```

Run it locally to pay in USDC; your wallet key stays on your machine. The hosted MCP endpoint takes an API key from a card credit purchase. Never send a wallet private key to any hosted service.
